source.figure_table: Abstract of the Townes humanized mouse model paper (per-cell F-cell proportion over time)

context.model: Townes humanized knock-in mouse model (human γβAS βS globin genes)

observation.assay: Proportion of F cells in peripheral blood
observation.unit: % peripheral blood (sustained with HU begun at P2; without HU, F cells virtually undetectable at P14)
observation.evidence_locator: Exp Hematol PMID 35843392; abstract: 'proportion of F cells in peripheral blood was 100% at P0, declined sharply to 20% at P2... Hydroxyurea given at P2 significantly sustained elevated percentages of F cells in mice at P14'

note: Townes mouse model: F cells 100% at P0, 20% at P2; HU begun at P2 sustains F cells at P14 (without HU, F cells virtually undetectable at P14). Decoupling of persistent F-cell elevation (P-003) from γ-globin RNA induction (P-004 gap).
